gloss: the three essential New Year's dishes

definitions.gloss: the three essential New Year's dishes
definitions.explanation: The three symbolic dishes regarded as indispensable to {御節|おせち} New Year's cuisine. In eastern Japan they are {黒豆|くろまめ} (sweet black beans), {数|かず}の{子|こ} (herring roe), and {田作|たづく}り (candied dried sardines); in western Japan {田作|たづく}り is replaced by たたきごぼう (pounded burdock).

examples.japanese: {三|み}つ{肴|ざかな}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{必|かなら}ず→必ず：01249_kanarazu⟧⟦{用意|ようい}する→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧。
examples.english: We always prepare at least the three essential dishes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{関西|かんさい}→関西：00179_kansai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{三|み}つ{肴|ざかな}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ ⟦たたきごぼう→たたきごぼう：30559_tatakigobou⟧ ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: The western Japanese version of the three dishes includes pounded burdock.

examples.japanese: {御節|おせち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{三|み}つ{肴|ざかな}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{雑煮|ぞうに}→雑煮：14581_zouni⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧にした。
examples.english: We didn't have time to make a full osechi spread, so we settled for the three essential dishes and zoni soup.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {三|み}つ{肴|ざかな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧そろえる: to assemble the three dishes
- ⟦{祝|いわ}い{肴|ざかな}→祝い肴：30554_iwaizakana⟧{三種|さんしゅ}: the three celebratory dishes (formal synonym)
- ⟦{関東|かんとう}→関東：00186_kantou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{三|み}つ{肴|ざかな}: the eastern Japanese set

CULTURAL NOTE:
Each dish carries a wish: ⟦{黒豆|くろまめ}→黒豆：30552_kuromame⟧ for health and diligence, ⟦{数|かず}の{子|こ}→数の子：30539_kazunoko⟧ for many descendants, and ⟦{田作|たづく}り→田作り：30553_tazukuri⟧ for an abundant harvest. Because these three alone are said to make a proper New Year's table, they are the minimum many households keep even when skipping the rest of the {御節|おせち}.
